units.known_address_notes: Audit is the Loopring Hebao v1 smart wallet (BaseVault.execute replay). Wayback CDX proves the code lived at Loopring/protocols packages/hebao_v1 (audit_report_solidified_response.md, docs/DESIGN.md) but every current raw path under master/main now 404s (folder removed/archived), so no config or deployment manifest is retrievable. Hebao v1 module/factory mainnet addresses are not published on any surviving docs page found; none recorded.

Guardian review (Nov 2025) of the Manifest Finance Protocol: Uniswap-v4 hook (AuthHook.sol) plus StakedUSHBase / sUSH with KYC-sanctions gating; scope repo gitlab.com/manifest-finance/ush is private (GitLab API 404), report states no chain and no addresses. DefiLlama 'Manifest' (Ethereum 0x21585BBcD5bDC3f5737620cf0Db2E51978cf60AC) resolves to an unrelated 'ManifestERC20Token' v0.7.5 and is excluded. Deployed USH/sUSH/hook not located; chain assumed Ethereum (v4 hooks).
